name: -a
--append
options.description: Append to target file when uploading

name: -f
--fail
options.description: Fail silently (no output at all) on HTTP errors

name: -G
--get
options.description: Put the post data in the URL and use GET

name: -g
--globoff
options.description: Disable URL sequences and ranges using {} and []

name: -i
--include
options.description: Include protocol response headers in the output

name: -k
--insecure
options.description: Allow insecure server connections when using SSL

name: -j
--junk-session-cookies
options.description: Ignore session cookies read from file

name: -m
--max-time
options.description: Maximum time allowed for the transfer

name: -n
--netrc
options.description: Must read .netrc for user name and password

name: --next
options.description: Make next URL use its separate set of options

name: -N
--no-buffer
options.description: Disable buffering of the output stream

name: -o
--output
options.description: Write to file instead of stdout

name: --progress-bar
options.description: Display transfer progress as a bar

name: -p
--proxytunnel
options.description: Operate through an HTTP proxy tunnel (using CONNECT)

name: -Q
--quote
options.description: Send command(s) to server before transfer

name: -r
--range
options.description: Retrieve only the bytes within RANGE

name: -O
--remote-name
options.description: Write output to a file named as the remote file

name: -S
--show-error
options.description: Show error even when -s is used

name: -z
--time-cond
options.description: Transfer based on a time condition

name: --abstract-unix-socket
options.description: Connect via abstract Unix domain socket

name: --alt-svc
options.description: Name> Enable alt-svc with this cache file

options.description: CA certificate to verify peer against

options.description: CA directory to verify peer against

options.description: Verify the status of the server certificate

options.description: Of ciphers> SSL ciphers to use

options.description: Convert LF to CRLF in upload

options.description: Get a CRL list in PEM format from the given file

options.description: Interface to use for DNS requests

options.description: IPv4 address to use for DNS requests

options.description: IPv6 address to use for DNS requests

options.description: EGD socket path for random data

options.description: Make a conditional HTTP request for the ETag read from the given file

options.description: Save an HTTP ETag to the specified file

options.description: Fail on first transfer error, do not continue

options.description: On HTTP errors, return an error and also output any HTML response

options.description: Create the remote dirs if not present

options.description: Require SSL/TLS for FTP login, clear for transfer

options.description: Send HAProxy PROXY protocol v1 header

options.description: Acceptable MD5 hash of the host public key

options.description: Ignore the size of the remote resource

options.description: Dump libcurl equivalent code of this command line

options.description: Force use of RANGE for local port numbers

options.description: Like --location, and send auth to other hosts

options.description: Originator address of the original email

options.description: Disable TCP keepalive on the connection

options.description: Pass phrase for the private key
